free_tier.stated: A programme that granted recurring infrastructure credits to open-source projects was ended without a first-party announcement. The letter quoted by recipients: 'DigitalOcean has decided to sunset the Open Source Credits Program. As part of this change, we are no longer accepting new credit applications or approving credit renewals, extensions, or additional credit requests.' Existing grants are honoured. A second outlet states: 'there is no official announcement on DigitalOcean's blog or social media handles. The program is being ended quietly.'

retention.stated: The closure was communicated only by email to participants, so a reader checking the vendor's public pages would still find the programme described as available, which is the exact failure this topic exists to name.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: With this programme closed, the routes into DigitalOcean that remain are the paid plans and the one-time startup credit.
